messages:
sam: quick heads-up: CIS scan on staging/base-image flagged a few things that affect deploy gating.

laura: what came up?

sam: world-writable /tmp, old openssl package, and several tags missing cosign signatures.

michael: missing signatures are blocking. Do we know if cosign failed or skipped?

sam: bake logs show cosign errors: KMS 'permission denied'. looks like the builder principal lost kms.cryptoSign after the RBAC tighten last sprint.

kevin: that was my change 94 I scoped the builder role to reduce blast radius. I didn't realize the bake used that principal for cosign. I can add a narrowly scoped kms.cryptoSign binding for the cosign key.

laura: please add it with an expiry tag and include a PR note. Also add a fail-fast verify in the bake job so unsigned images fail.

michael: suggested verify snippet: 
cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/cosign-key $IMAGE || (echo "unsigned image" && exit 1)

kevin: will do. I'll open PR with expiry and rollback instructions (remove binding via gcloud).

sam: question on existing unsigned images: rebuild+repush or resign in-place?

michael: rebuild+repush. Retaining provenance is important for audits; in-place re-sign breaks attestation metadata.

laura: audit asks for image pull events in our timeline; right now we only have kubelet start/stop. We should enable containerd pull/create forwarding in staging with a filter to avoid noise.

ops-bot: recommended staging config snippet: containerd.enabled=true; containerd.events=["pull","create"]; filters: event==pull -> fields: [image,digest,node,registry].

kevin: test in staging first. if shipper load spikes we can sample or rate-limit.

sam: propose short plan: 1) add scoped KMS binding and expiry 2) require cosign verify in bake 3) enable containerd pull forwarding in staging with filter 4) schedule base-image rebuild this week and canary deploy.

michael: I'll own the rebuild runway. prefer Thu 01:00-03:00 PT canary then promote after smoke tests.

laura: add rollback runbook to the PR: steps to remove binding, how to mark tags quarantined in registry to block deploys, and how to revert bake change.

kevin: PR link will be posted when ready. tagging @sam for quick approval.

audit-bot: scan-results: staging/base-image:2026-09-21 failed CIS checks (5). https://ci.internal/scans/3623456789

sam: thanks. once PR is merged we'll trigger rebuild and post results. :thumbsup:
